-- Driven entirely by edenAgents.ts (TS), which runs the person's mind
-- (src/eden/mind.ts) and broadcasts a new target via
-- editor_ui_event("eden_target_adam", "x,y,z,action,speed") whenever the mind
-- decides something new. This script only
-- ever walks toward the last target it was given and plays that action's
-- clip on arrival -- it has no say in WHAT Adam does, only HOW he gets
-- there. The sandboxed Lua VM has no network access at all by design (see
-- source/engine/script/script.cpp's open_sandboxed_libs), so the decision
-- itself can only ever be made outside it.

-- "Man (casual)" (catalog id 249) carries its own clips (idle/talk/run/
-- walk/Wave/Death/HitRecieve) -- already a clothed, fully-animated model,
-- so there's no outfit to dress (unlike the clip-less UBC base bodies).

local target = nil -- {x, y, z, action}
local waypoints = nil
local wpIndex = 1
local arrived = true
local playedAction = nil
local WALK_SPEED = 1.6
local dead = false

local function parse_target(value)
  local parts = {}
  for p in string.gmatch(value, "[^,]+") do parts[#parts + 1] = p end
  if #parts < 4 then return nil end
  return { x = tonumber(parts[1]), y = tonumber(parts[2]), z = tonumber(parts[3]), action = parts[4], speed = tonumber(parts[5]), viaX = tonumber(parts[6]), viaZ = tonumber(parts[7]) }
end

function on_ui(name, value)
  -- Put down where the mind says they are (fast time, a move by the Creator, a loaded world): no walking there.
  if name == "eden_snap_adam" then
    local x, y, z = string.match(value, "^([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)$")
    x, y, z = tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z)
    if x and y and z then
      self.x, self.y, self.z = x, y + 0.3, z
      self.vx, self.vz = 0, 0
      target, waypoints, arrived = nil, nil, true
    end
    return
  end
  if name == "eden_die_adam" then
    dead = true
    target, waypoints, arrived = nil, nil, true
    self.vx, self.vz = 0, 0
    self.animate = "Death"
    return
  end
  if dead then return end
  if name ~= "eden_target_adam" then return end
  local t = parse_target(value)
  if not t then return end
  target = t
  waypoints = world.path(self.x, self.y, self.z, t.x, t.y, t.z)
  -- No route found (the path grid does not cover open terrain): walk straight at the target and let physics steer round what is in the way.
  if not waypoints or #waypoints == 0 then waypoints = { { x = t.x, y = t.y, z = t.z } } end
  -- A lake is in the way: round its bank first (the page worked out the point).
  if t.viaX and t.viaZ then waypoints = { { x = t.viaX, y = t.y, z = t.viaZ }, { x = t.x, y = t.y, z = t.z } } end
  wpIndex = 1
  arrived = false
end

local function play(action)
  if playedAction ~= action then
    self.animate = action
    playedAction = action
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  if dead or not target then return end
  if arrived then
    self.vx, self.vz = 0, 0
    play(target.action)
    return
  end
  if not waypoints or #waypoints == 0 then
    -- Unreachable (world.path found nothing, or start == target): stand
    -- and play the action anyway rather than getting stuck on nothing.
    arrived = true
    return
  end
  local wp = waypoints[wpIndex]
  local dx, dz = wp.x - self.x, wp.z - self.z
  local dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
  if dist < 0.3 then
    wpIndex = wpIndex + 1
    if wpIndex > #waypoints then
      arrived = true
      self.vx, self.vz = 0, 0
      play(target.action)
      return
    end
  else
    self.vx = (dx / dist) * (target.speed or WALK_SPEED)
    self.vz = (dz / dist) * (target.speed or WALK_SPEED)
    play((target.speed or WALK_SPEED) > 3 and "run" or "walk")
  end
end

-- Eden Phase 3: a logic-only entity (no mesh of its own, see build_eden.ts's
-- "Creator" entity) that fulfils "let there be..." requests. It never
-- decides WHAT to spawn -- the Creator panel (edenAgents.ts) already
-- resolved a prefab name client-side, fuzzy-matched against Eden's own
-- named prefabs, before this ever fires. This script exists only because
-- world.spawn is Lua-only -- nothing TS-side can call it directly.

local placed = {} -- id -> entity, for what the people have built

function on_ui(name, value)
  -- The mind's clock: light the scene for the hour (sun, moon, sky and fog).
  if name == "eden_time" then
    local hours = tonumber(value)
    if hours then fx.time_of_day(hours) end
    return
  end
  -- The people build things: "id,prefab,x,y,z" puts one there (the host knows the ground's height), "id" takes it away again (a fire gone out).
  if name == "eden_place" then
    -- "id,prefab,x,y,z" or "id,prefab,x,y,z,who" (a person's body: it is told its name)
    local id, prefab, x, y, z, who = string.match(value, "^([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+),?(.*)$")
    x, y, z = tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z)
    if not (id and prefab and x and y and z) then return end
    local e = world.spawn(prefab, x, y, z)
    placed[id] = e
    if e and who and who ~= "" then world.send(e, "eden_who", who) end
    return
  end
  -- A creature that has moved: "id,x,y,z".
  if name == "eden_move" then
    local id, x, y, z = string.match(value, "^([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)$")
    x, y, z = tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z)
    local e = id and placed[id]
    if e and x and y and z then world.set_position(e, x, y, z) end
    return
  end
  if name == "eden_remove" then
    local e = placed[value]
    if e then world.destroy(e) end
    placed[value] = nil
    return
  end
  -- The weather: "rain,fog" (0-1) for the sky and the sound of it.
  if name == "eden_weather" then
    local rain, fog, wx, wz = string.match(value, "^([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)$")
    if rain then fx.weather(tonumber(rain) or 0, tonumber(fog) or 0, tonumber(wx) or 1.5, tonumber(wz) or 0.5) end
    return
  end
  if name ~= "eden_create" then return end
  local parts = {}
  for p in string.gmatch(value, "[^,]+") do parts[#parts + 1] = p end
  if #parts < 4 then return end
  local prefab = parts[1]
  local x, y, z = tonumber(parts[2]), tonumber(parts[3]), tonumber(parts[4])
  if not (x and y and z) then return end
  world.spawn(prefab, x, y, z)
end

  if t.viaX and t.viaZ then waypoints = { { x = t.viaX, y = t.y, z = t.viaZ }, { x = t.x, y = t.y, z = t.z } } end
  wpIndex = 1
  arrived = false
end

local function play(action)
  if playedAction ~= action then
    self.animate = action
    playedAction = action
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  if dead or not target then return end
  if arrived then
    self.vx, self.vz = 0, 0
    play(target.action)
    return
  end
  if not waypoints or #waypoints == 0 then
    -- Unreachable (world.path found nothing, or start == target): stand
    -- and play the action anyway rather than getting stuck on nothing.
    arrived = true
    return
  end
  local wp = waypoints[wpIndex]
  local dx, dz = wp.x - self.x, wp.z - self.z
  local dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
  if dist < 0.3 then
    wpIndex = wpIndex + 1
    if wpIndex > #waypoints then
      arrived = true
      self.vx, self.vz = 0, 0
      play(target.action)
      return
    end
  else
    self.vx = (dx / dist) * (target.speed or WALK_SPEED)
    self.vz = (dz / dist) * (target.speed or WALK_SPEED)
    play((target.speed or WALK_SPEED) > 3 and "run" or "walk")
  end
end
